title: Site Visit Booking and Reminder Agent
summary: Book site visits against sales manager slots, confirm and remind by voice and WhatsApp, rearrange pick-ups, recover no-shows and capture post-visit feedback for the sales team.

seo.title: Site Visit Booking and Reminder Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: AI agent that books property site visits, sends voice and WhatsApp reminders with location, reschedules no-shows and logs post-visit feedback in the CRM.

problem.intro: For most housing projects the site visit is the step that turns an enquiry into a booking. Visits cluster on weekends, sales managers are double-booked one hour and idle the next, and many scheduled visitors simply do not turn up.

pain_points.title: Weekend crush, weekday gaps
pain_points.detail: Visits pile up on Saturday and Sunday afternoons while sales managers have free weekday slots, and the sample flat gets crowded.

pain_points.title: No-shows with no follow-up
pain_points.detail: When a visitor does not arrive, nobody calls the same day, and the lead drifts to another project.

pain_points.title: Logistics handled by hand
pain_points.detail: Location pins, pick-up cabs, parking and who will meet the visitor are coordinated over personal phones.

pain_points.title: Feedback lost after the visit
pain_points.detail: Objections about price, layout, floor or location are discussed at site but rarely recorded, so follow-up stays generic.

solution.overview: We build a voice and WhatsApp agent that manages the site visit from booking to follow-up. It offers slots from each sales manager's calendar and the sample flat's capacity, nudges flexible visitors towards weekday slots, and confirms on WhatsApp with the location pin, landmark and contact person. It calls or messages the day before and on the morning of the visit, arranges or changes a pick-up if you offer one, and alerts the site team when a visitor is running late. If a visitor does not arrive, it calls to reschedule the same day. After the visit it calls for feedback, records objections and the next step, and updates the CRM.
capabilities: Slot booking against sales manager calendars and sample flat capacity
WhatsApp confirmation with location pin, landmark, parking and contact person
Day-before and same-day reminders by voice or WhatsApp, with one-tap rescheduling
Pick-up requests and changes routed to the transport coordinator
Same-day no-show calls to reschedule or close the lead with a reason
Post-visit feedback calls capturing objections, interest level and next step

workflow.title: Book the visit
workflow.detail: Leads from presales or the qualification agent are offered slots from sales manager calendars, and the booking is written to the CRM.

workflow.title: Confirm and share directions
workflow.detail: A WhatsApp confirmation carries the location pin, timing, contact person and pick-up details if requested.

workflow.title: Remind and reconfirm
workflow.detail: The agent reminds the visitor the day before and that morning, and offers to reschedule if plans have changed.

workflow.title: Track arrival
workflow.detail: The site team marks arrival, and late or missing visitors trigger a call.

workflow.title: Recover no-shows
workflow.detail: Visitors who did not arrive are called the same day to reschedule or to record why they dropped out.

workflow.title: Collect feedback
workflow.detail: After the visit, the agent calls for feedback and objections, and the sales manager reviews the summary and sets the next action.

inputs: Project location pin, landmarks and parking details
Pick-up policy and transport coordinator contacts
outputs: Booked, confirmed and rescheduled visits in the CRM
Reminder and confirmation history per lead
Weekly visit funnel report by source and sales manager
human_in_the_loop: Sales managers review every post-visit summary and set the next action, and the site team confirms arrivals. Requests about price negotiation, specific unit allocation or complaints are passed to a person immediately.
integrations: Real estate CRM such as Salesforce, LeadSquared or Sell.Do
Cab booking or transport coordinator workflow
guardrails: Uses only pre-approved WhatsApp templates for business-initiated messages
Limits reminders to an agreed number per visit and honours opt-outs
Does not discuss price negotiation or unit allocation
Shares contact details of the site team only with the lead who booked
Every call and message logged against the lead
compliance_notes: WhatsApp messaging follows Meta's opt-in and template rules, and calls respect TRAI preferences and your consent records.
Visitor contact details and feedback are processed for the stated purpose under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: One project's site visits over three weekends, with the agent handling confirmations, reminders, no-show calls and feedback for a defined set of bookings.
deliverables: Booking and reminder flows connected to your CRM and calendars
Feedback call script in Hindi and English

faqs.a: Yes. The WhatsApp confirmation includes reschedule and cancel options, and the voice agent can change the slot during a reminder call. Changes update the sales manager's calendar straight away.

faqs.q: How does it know a visitor has arrived?
faqs.a: The site team marks arrival on a simple screen or the CRM app, or scans the QR code from the visitor's confirmation at reception. Without an arrival mark, the agent follows up as a possible no-show.

faqs.q: Will it annoy buyers with too many messages?
faqs.a: We agree a reminder limit per visit with your team and stop as soon as the visitor confirms or opts out. Messages are short and carry only what the visitor needs.

faqs.q: Does it work across multiple projects?
faqs.a: Yes. Each project has its own location details, slots and sales roster, and leads interested in more than one project can be offered combined visits if your team runs them.
